verdict.rationale: Clerk's changelog describes a standards-based OAuth grant that lets CLIs and other browser-less devices have a user approve access from a browser-capable device. That is the device authorization flow, so it replaces pasting secrets on the original device. Clerk's OAuth scoped access and custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients round out the delegated-access story. Missing for 10: dedicated in-depth docs for the device grant (endpoints, polling, token lifetimes, refresh), explicit coverage of headless agents beyond CLIs and devices, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
